QuestInfo.name: [11th Anniversary] Lost and Found
QuestInfo.0:
Once upon a time, monsters built vaults to hide their treasure from pesky adventurers.
But over the years, their whereabouts were all forgotten. 
Slime wants you to find these vaults.

#bLocate the portals hidden in each town, one per town,
to discover all 8 forgotten treasure storages!
